description: Harness-neutral discovery catalog for Multimodal DataPrep workflow skills. Paths are relative to the microservice root.

skills.name: multimodal-dataprep-user
skills.description: Deploy and consume the Multimodal DataPrep ingestion stack with pluggable vector and object storage backends: bring it up from a repo clone (setup.sh) or standalone via the skill's compose file with prebuilt images, then upload/ingest videos, register and manage live RTSP camera streams, add text summaries, and list/download/delete videos through the REST API on port 6007. Ingestion only — this service does not answer search queries. Not for modifying its source (use multimodal-dataprep-dev).
triggers: store media embeddings in a vector database

skills.name: multimodal-dataprep-dev
skills.description: Develop the Multimodal DataPrep microservice itself: build images the sanctioned way (./build.sh, context three levels up), run the pytest suite with coverage, lint, and navigate the SDK/API embedding pipeline and live-stream (src/core/live/) code. Not for merely deploying or ingesting videos (use multimodal-dataprep-user).
triggers: docker build fails on embedding path dependency
